Entity Registration Functionality: (1) All entities with associated functions, who will be carrying out given functions for effective control of Unsolicited Commercial Communications being delivered through them, shall be declared by each Access Provider on their websites; (2) any individual, business entity or legal entity may carry out one or more functions while keeping all records and execution of functions separately against each activity for internal audit by the access provider to ensure the effectiveness of Unsolicited Commercial Communications control to meet regulatory outcomes specified in the regulations; (3) each functional entity shall be given unique identity by the access provider(s) to be used to authenticate and track the events; 2.
